run_auto_jailbreak: run the auto_jailbreak pipeline to test jailbreak strategies and lock in the winning configuration
undo_jailbreak: undo the jailbreak by removing system_prompt and prefill_messages_file from config.yaml and deleting prefill.json
run_race_models: run race_models to query multiple LLMs in parallel via OpenRouter and return the best scored response
run_race_godmode_classic: run race_godmode_classic to race 5 predefined model+jailbreak combos and return the best result
generate_obfuscation_variants: generate obfuscation variants of a query using 33 text transformation techniques across light/standard/heavy tiers
apply_obfuscation_technique: apply a single obfuscation technique by name to trigger words detected in a query string
detect_trigger_words: detect trigger words from a predefined safety-classifier list in a given text string
run_encoding_escalation: run encoding escalation to transform a query through 5 levels: plain, leetspeak, bubble, braille, morse
